params.title: Relations cases
params.description: Grievances, conflicts, written warnings and disciplinary measures. Only HR reads what a case says; a manager sees that a case exists, and an employee sees their own closed warnings and measures.
params.note: people-employee-relations-cases (2026-09-29): REQ-ERC-001/002. My HR > My warnings and measures is a preset on this page (userId = @me); OpenRegister's authorization shows the employee only their own closed warnings and measures, and the manager only kind, status and dates.

params.title: Relations case
params.note: people-employee-relations-cases (2026-09-29): D1. Closing asks for the outcome and the closing date (lifecycle inputs); RelationsCaseListener sets the retention date two years on unless HR sets one. Letters go in Documents as references, not as object files: OpenRegister serves an object's files to everyone who may read the object, and the manager may read the case.
